b.span: 🧭 Roadmap · what I would harden next

div.span:
• least-privilege CI role (today broad, but scoped to one project) • HTTPS listener on the Gateway (cert-manager) • External Secrets Operator + Secrets Manager (endpoint already in place)
• Cosign signing + Kyverno verifyImages • restrict / privatise the EKS API endpoint • kube-prometheus-stack + Hubble • Kyverno in HA • tfsec / Checkov • dev → staging → prod promotion

text.tspan: 🧭 Roadmap · what I would harden next
• least-privilege CI role (today broad, but scoped to one project) • HTTPS listener on the Gateway (cert-manager) • External Secrets Operator + Secrets Manager (endpoint already in place)
• Cosign signing + Kyverno verifyImages • restrict / privatise the EKS API endpoint • kube-prometheus-stack + Hubble • Kyverno in HA • tfsec / Checkov • dev → staging → prod promotion
